exposure: Delivery Room Intensive Care Unit (DICU) model
cohort: The study included 2,788 preterm infants admitted following a transition from a NICU-centered approach to a DICU early intervention model.
finding: The standardized Delivery Room Intensive Care Unit (DICU) model significantly reduced the incidences of intraventricular hemorrhage, hypothermia, apnea, perinatal respiratory diseases, and metabolic acidosis in preterm infants, and a nomogram was developed for predicting IVH risk.
